subject: Acceptance window pressure — cadence gap, proposed mitigation & exec confirmation request
messages:
From: Dana Lopez <dana.lopez@zenira.health>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@zenira.health, evan.reed@zenira.health
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Acceptance window — alignment and outstanding items

Hi Grace,

Quick note from the evaluation team: our clinical integration and security groups hit a block this week during the SOC-approvals walkthrough. The security team has requested an expanded evidence set (attached) and wants a short window to run end-to-end data masking verification in our pre-prod. Separately, procurement is still waiting on a signed SOW/PO — their internal SLA says they won’t sign until the updated T&Cs are cleared; that is slipping our acceptance milestone.

We reviewed the MAP you sent (Zenira_MAP_v3.xlsx) and there are three asks on our side:
- Can Redwood provide a 10-calendar-day extension on the Acceptance window (we're currently at the end of Aug target)?
- Can you enable a short-lived dedicated test GPU for our team to run the integration (read: deterministic environment for the week of Aug 2)?
- If procurement can’t sign by Aug 5, what commercial remedy / one-time concession will Redwood offer if acceptance is pushed beyond the MAP?

We'd like to resolve this without formal escalation but need firm next steps today. I've attached the security evidence request they circulated.

Thanks,
Dana
Dana Lopez
Director, Clinical Integrations
Zenira Health
[Attachment: SOC2-evidence-request.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: Zenira_MAP_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
To: Dana Lopez <dana.lopez@zenira.health>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acceptance window — alignment and outstanding items

Dana — thank you for the heads up and for the attachments. I pulled the MAP and the SOC request into our ops room; quick answers below and proposed plan.

Short answers:
- Extension: we can commit to a 7-business-day extension (10 calendar days) to the Acceptance window as a first pass; we'll formalize via a short addendum if that’s acceptable to you.
- Dedicated test capacity: yes — we can stand up a reserved pre-prod slot for your team for one full week (up to 48 hrs of testing runtime per day). We'll need a narrow IP/CIDR allowlist and an internal runbook which I can share.
- Commercial remedy: Ben (cc'd) is looping Finance/Commercial — we can offer a one-time credit for missed go-live against the first two months of usage (amount TBD with Ben).

Proposed next steps (timeline for today):
1) Zenira confirms procurement ETA (Aug 5 or earlier). If procurement signs by Aug 5 we keep current MAP end date + 10 days.
2) If procurement misses Aug 5, Redwood issues a single-page addendum extending acceptance window + provisioning dedicated test capacity the week of Aug 2.
3) Ben to propose credit amount and confirm approval path.

We will attach an acceptance_risk_log and a clean addendum template to the MAP; sharing now: RDW_proposed_acceptance_adjustment.xlsx (I’ll upload to the deal record as well). Can you confirm procurement’s current blocking item so we can triage it with legal if needed?

On Wed, Jul 28, 2027, Dana Lopez <dana.lopez@zenira.health> wrote:
> Quick note from the evaluation team: our clinical integration and security groups hit a block this week during the SOC-approvals walkthrough...

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0142
[Attachment: RDW_proposed_acceptance_adjustment.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Lopez <dana.lopez@zenira.health>, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acceptance window — alignment and outstanding items

Dana / Grace — quick commercial note. If procurement is the blocker and the acceptance milestone slips beyond the MAP, Redwood is prepared to:

- Offer a one-time credit equal to 30% of the first month’s forecasted token/compute spend (applies once, to offset the missed acceptance window).
- Accept an LOI (Letter of Intent) with deposit + SOW addendum in lieu of a signed PO to allow the MAP to proceed operationally.

Both of these require sign-off from Finance. Grace — I’ll escalate internally to Markus to get provisional approval; I expect back within 48 hours.

Ben
Ben Carter
Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
[internal note: proposed credit contingent on Finance review; scope to be tightened in addendum]

From: Dana Lopez <dana.lopez@zenira.health>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@zenira.health, evan.reed@zenira.health
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acceptance window — alignment and outstanding items

Grace / Ben — thanks for the quick replies. Procurement has two blockers: (1) legal redline around the data retention clause that their counsel wants revised, (2) internal approval queue for budget which may not clear before Aug 5.

We can do an LOI with deposit (Evan included here) to hold the MAP but procurement wants a commercial written confirmation from Redwood about the proposed credit and the exact extension duration before they commit. Can you provide a one-page addendum + an executive confirmation (email from a senior leader) that outlines: extension length, the credit commitment, and the dedicated pre-prod access window?

If we get that by EOD Aug 2 we will push procurement to approve the LOI and proceed with the pre-prod run next week.

Dana
Dana Lopez
Director, Clinical Integrations
Zenira Health
[Attachment: procurement_blockers_summary.txt]

From: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 17:23:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Acceptance window — executive confirm request (Zenira Health)

Markus — forwarding the thread. Short summary and ask below.

Summary:
- Zenira's procurement/legal are stalling acceptance due to a data-retention redline and an internal budget queue.
- Client is willing to sign an LOI + deposit if Redwood provides: (A) a short addendum extending the Acceptance window by 10 calendar days, (B) confirmation of a one-time commercial credit if acceptance slips beyond the extended window, and (C) a committed pre-prod reserved slot the week of Aug 2 for deterministic validation.

Why this matters: the MAP is currently the gating mechanism for go-live approvals; if procurement pushes beyond Aug 12 we risk an org-level delay and the deal's Q3 recognition. The client will not proceed operationally without the written commit.

Requested action:
1) Executive note from you (email OK) confirming Redwood will approve the proposed credit (up to the amount Ben recommended — we can tighten language to "subject to Finance review" if you prefer).
2) Approval to issue the single-page addendum (legal has a template ready).
3) Priority for the pre-prod capacity request (we’ll bill only if they exceed the reserved window).

Attached the risk log I started (acceptance_risk_log_2027-08-02.csv). If you OK, I will send the addendum to Dana this evening and ask for LOI sign by EOD.

Thanks — I’ll be standing by for your greenlight.

Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0142
